author: joserr93
quote: Una obra maestra de principio a fin. Me encantó jugarlo en mi niñez y me encantó revivirlo en la actualidad
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998)

author: joserr93
quote: For me, this is one of the greatest games of all time, and I feel lucky to be part of the generation that experienced it for the first time on the Nintendo 64. I absolutely loved exploring every detail of its different locations, temples, and the castle. Everything about this game is special. A perfect 10/10 for me!
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
